name: molt-monorepo
description: Molt — a general plugin runtime for safe replacement. Root workspace: tooling and scripts only; published code lives in packages/.

scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r lint && pnpm knip
scripts.test:adapters: pnpm --filter @molt/test test && pnpm --filter @molt/events test && pnpm --filter @molt/react test && pnpm --filter @molt/vite test && pnpm --filter @molt/sqlite test && pnpm --filter @molt/example-command-host test && pnpm --filter @molt/example-worker-host test
scripts.check:pkg: pnpm --filter @molt/runtime --filter @molt/test --filter @molt/events --filter @molt/react --filter @molt/vite --filter @molt/sqlite exec publint && pnpm --filter @molt/runtime --filter @molt/test --filter @molt/events --filter @molt/react --filter @molt/vite --filter @molt/sqlite exec attw --pack .
